Independent2wall safeguards monitor active local R clock progress and independent TimeController administrative liveness/failure; coordinator bounds physical inflight ACK in every mode from each actual issue, and activates RUN clock/native ACK progress protection once on the first same-session status observing any actual R Guard armed. The separate armed-since monotonic baseline never renews on repeated status/ARM/HOLD-to-RUN, and actual clock/native progress stamps are never fabricated from bootstrap tokens; each deadline uses the later of armed-since and actual progress. Unarmed preflight retains the original startup180wall bound and per-physicalRPC2wall protection. Explicit preflight HOLD/STOP before ARM does not grant permission or permanently revoke future ARM; an armed HOLD without authority exit faults, and verified authority-exit STOP_OBSERVE (including its following HOLD before expected-shutdown is latched) revokes permission and uses actual UUID cancel/zero/PAUSE without synthesizing business outcomes. Authority-stopped stop observation has no business permission; physical inflight still has a2wall bound. All callback/timing/achieved workload/availability/trajectories can differ; rebuild matched A0/A1/B/C baselines. No wall-real-time deployment or physics/stop guarantee follows from this profile; frozen policy and physical evidence remain required.
